purpose: Teach: 伯/持ち帰っ/さきほど/面倒くさい/無制限/危うく/浮かば/軽快

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ご結婚のお祝いに、伯母さん、本気で、お祝い、いっぱい、くださったの、感謝してる。
lines.en: Aoi — I'm really grateful that your aunt gave so much for your wedding celebration.
lines.style: Warm opening with genuine affection. Voice settles into tenderness. Steady pacing, unhurried. Slight smile in the delivery, like sharing in quiet joy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お弁当、お客様、本気で、持ち帰ったの、嬉しい話よね、葵で、好評ね、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. And honestly, I'm so glad the customers took home those lunch boxes — they've been getting great feedback.
lines.style: Bright and engaged. Quick upswing on the positive news. Natural enthusiasm without performing it. Voice lifts at the mention of customer response.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: さきほど、彼から、お電話、入ってきたの、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、嬉しい、ね、絶対。
lines.en: Earlier, my boyfriend called — Aoi, he was really happy. I mean, I could tell he was genuinely happy.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Pause after 'called' to let the moment settle. Tender undertone, like she's still processing the warmth of it. Trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 業務日誌、面倒くさいけど、本気で、続けていかないとね、葵で、絶対、必要、メイちゃん、わかる?
lines.en: The business log is tedious, but we really do need to keep it going — do you understand? It matters, Mei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly grounded. Shift to something more purposeful midway through. Not lecturing, but clear-eyed about what needs to happen. Steady, practical concern.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、無制限の自由、お客様にも、感じてもらいたいわよね、葵、本気で、メイちゃん、応援してるわよ。
lines.en: I want your customers to feel that same kind of freedom in your shop, you know? I really do believe in what you're building, Aoi.
lines.style: Sincere and encouraging. Builds gently toward conviction. Voice rests on 'believe' with quiet certainty. The tone of someone who means it and isn't asking permission to say so.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今朝、危うく、寝坊するところだったわよ、葵、本気で、慌てたわよ、メイちゃん、絶対、笑えるよね、本気。
lines.en: This morning I almost overslept — honestly, I was so panicked. You'd laugh if you'd seen me scrambling, Mei.
lines.style: Wry, almost self-deprecating. Light on the absurdity of nearly oversleeping. Quick, breathless quality when describing the panic. Inviting laughter, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新しいレシピのアイディア、なかなか、浮かばないわよね、葵、本気で、頑張ろうね、絶対、応援してる。
lines.en: New recipe ideas just aren't coming to me easily right now. But let's keep pushing through this together, Aoi — I'm rooting for you.
lines.style: Gentle but steady. Acknowledges the struggle without lingering on it. Shifts to encouragement with quiet resolve. Voice firms slightly on 'rooting for you,' offering real support.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の最新メニュー、軽快な味わいで、お客様、本気で、好評よ、メイちゃん、絶対、試してみて、本気で。
lines.en: Your new menu items are getting wonderful feedback — the flavors are so light and approachable. You really should try them, Mei.
lines.style: Bright, proud finish. Voice lifts with genuine delight in sharing good news. Inviting, not insistent. Warm close, like she's offering something she believes in.
